short_description: The successor to Tefnut's Expansion, remade from the ground up. A mod that aims to bring more hope and humor to whats normally a fairly grimdark setting.
description:
New Kitsune mutation line, Crackhead Engineering & Weird Science Skills and related crafts & weapons(oh my god the weapons), WW2 American & Japanese weapons, uniforms, and museums, Various modest maid uniforms and related gear,  Survivor-ified versions of blankets, cloaks, uniforms, wrist computers, maid outfits, etc., various foods and related recipes, wildlife, robots, and mutants, 4 brand new Professions and a new vehicle. + Vehicle parts, mounted guns, and grid-powered air conditioners and floodlights.

Plushies!!! Bodypillows!!!
author: Tefnut
